# Constructor Axis3D

#### Axis3D(Point3D, Direction3D)

Initializes a new instance of the Axis3D structure with a specified origin and direction.

##### Declaration

```
public Axis3D(Point3D inOrigin, Direction3D inDirection)
```

##### Parameters

|  Type |  Name |  Description |  
| --- | --- | --- | 
   
|  Point3D |  inOrigin |  Axis origin.  |  
 
|  Direction3D |  inDirection |  Axis direction.  |
